sources.claim: Jacob Davis co-patented copper-riveted work pants with Levi Strauss, patent granted May 20, 1873, US Patent #139121
sources.source: History.com ('Levi Strauss patents copper-riveted jeans'); Hagley Museum & Library; Reno Historical archive

sources.claim: Davis lacked funds for the patent filing and proposed Strauss (his fabric supplier) fund it for half interest, per his 1872 letter
sources.source: Hagley Museum & Library; National Archives Prologue blog
